info.title: HMS API
info.description:
Hospital Management System API.

**Signing in.** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with a Hospital Code, a username
(or email) and a password. Send the returned `accessToken` on every call as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie the
browser manages — send requests with `credentials: 'include'`.

**Access.** Each operation states who may call it: *Public*, *Any signed-in
user*, *Platform administrators only*, or the clinic **permission** it
requires. `GET /api/v1/auth/me` returns the signed-in user's permissions —
build navigation from those.

**Money** is always a string (`"1500.00"`), **instants** are ISO 8601 UTC,
**calendar dates** are `YYYY-MM-DD`, **ids** are ULID strings.

**Errors** share one envelope (`ErrorResponse`). Branch on `code`, never on
`message`. Show `requestId` to users on error screens.
